subject: Render DELTA3 lock/shadow tests PASS; options requires bridge v3 + request fields
body:

- B2: variants survive module reset (no clear/delete); fixed 32-slot array, pipeline-local genericVariantLock around lookup+compile+publish, acquire readers in plan_binding/required, release publication. Host test now resets modules and verifies array pointer/count/old code survive.
- Non-JM: exact sampler state still refuses under #ifndef NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT; JM sends exact state via v2.
- B4: tegu_shadow_sync_jobs scans v2Textures; refresh all, write back only usage ShaderWrite bit1. Added fake-IOSurface host test for refresh/writeback/skip-read-only; PASS.
- Item3 options: blocked. n2r v3 (first_provoking/FAU 64/68) exists in textures source, but bridge has only n2mb_draw_v2; no n2mb_draw_v3 and no Dispatch/request fields for vertexStart/baseInstance/flat options. Compute: please add/additive bridge v3 and request storage contract; textures: please post exact board contract/field names. I will wire tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options and remove the vertexStart refusal only after that, with a real host fixture.
